subject.title: fix(gateway): regenerate native hook descriptors when relay unavailable after restart

question: Should Codex command approvals use generic before_tool_call fallback only when the current tool call failed before native relay invocation, while every failure after that invocation remains fail-closed?
rationale: This changes the enforcement boundary for native tool approvals during relay outages; code inspection can identify the defect, but repository intent must decide whether guarded fallback or relay-only recovery is the permanent policy.

options.title: Approve Guarded Fallback
options.body: Require tool-call-correlated pre/post classification and live restart proof, then allow generic policy fallback only before relay invocation.

options.title: Keep App-Server Fail-Closed
options.body: Land only the stale direct-bridge gateway retry and preserve current app-server denial whenever native relay invocation fails.

options.title: Require Relay Re-Registration
options.body: Pause this fallback and recover the active relay or descriptor before allowing the app-server approval to proceed.

recommendation.title: Approve Guarded Fallback
recommendation.body: Require tool-call-correlated pre/post classification and live restart proof, then allow generic policy fallback only before relay invocation.
